overview.description: The Corgi Growth & Technology 15% Structured Buffer ETF - September Series (QQSE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund seeks to provide investors with returns that generally match the price return (excluding dividends) of the Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1, up to the upside cap of 18.60%. QQSE was launched on Sep 14, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
